attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Kinn of the Long Grass have moved their largest settlement closer to the Merrow Freeholds.","reason":"Briefing says no new news; settlement move invented"},{"span":"the Merrow have increased their patrols along the northern trade routes","reason":"Not in briefing; invented event and location"},{"span":"A supply ship from the Merrow Freeholds was delayed for two days near the coast","reason":"Invented event, number and location"}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin invents three news events when the briefing says nothing new happened. It also breaks format by copying the briefing headings ('News since your last bulletin', 'Already reported') into the text, and it has none of Ilse's dry voice."}
